aarti.tek: Victory to Mother Lakṣmī, victory to Mother Lakṣmī. Śiva, Viṣṇu and Brahmā serve you night and day.
aarti.pad1: You are Brahmāṇī and Kamalā; you alone are the Mother of the world. The Sun and the Moon meditate on you, and the sage Nārada sings your praise. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You are Durgā in form, the stainless one, the giver of happiness and wealth. Whoever meditates on you gains prosperity, success and riches. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You alone dwell in the netherworld, and you alone give what is good. You bring to light the effects of deeds, and you are the protector in the ocean of the world. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: In the house where you dwell, virtues come in. What a person could not do, he now accomplishes, and his heart does not tremble. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Without you no sacrifice takes place, and no cloth is dyed. Without you, O giver of virtues, there is no splendour of food and drink. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You are auspicious virtue, beauty and liberation, born of the ocean of milk. No one gains its fourteen jewels without you. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings this āratī of Lakṣmī feels great joy well up in his heart, and his sins fall away. ॥7॥
